Your permission comes first.

Each pairing code lasts 15 minutes and can only be claimed once. Both your phone and the laptop must approve the matching code before a device credential is issued.

Disconnecting a laptop invalidates its V2 device credential. Your local files and existing private installation are preserved.

Keep your password private. Social sign-in uses the provider’s login page, never your local SARAS app password.

Make yourself at home.

Appearance controls are available in the theme selector. AI and local Windows permissions stay in the companion’s existing setup.
